name: veil
description: Masks your secrets before your coding agent's model sees them.
author: Gonçalo Neves (https://github.com/goncaloneves)

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && claude plugin validate .
scripts.build:adapters: bun build src/adapters/pi/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/veil-pi.js && bun build src/adapters/opencode/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/veil-opencode.js
